name: The Ritz-Carlton, Abama
insider_take: Perched dramatically on volcanic cliffs above the Atlantic, The Ritz-Carlton, Abama is Tenerife's crown jewel — a Moorish-inspired paradise where two Michelin-starred dining, lush subtropical gardens, and one of Spain's finest golf courses collide in breathtaking fashion.
whats_special: Abama is one of the very few resorts in the Canary Islands to hold two Michelin-starred restaurants — MB by Martín Berasategui and Kabuki Raw — making it a true culinary destination. The resort's striking Moorish and Andalusian architecture feels like a hidden palace, while its private funicular whisks guests down to a secluded white-sand beach on the Atlantic coast. Set against the dramatic backdrop of Mount Teide, Spain's highest peak, the scenery alone is unforgettable.
pro_tip: Book a villa with a private pool for the most immersive experience — the tiered layout of the resort means many accommodations enjoy completely unobstructed views of the Atlantic. Sunset from your terrace here is simply next-level.
dont_miss: A round on the Abama Golf Course , designed by Dave Thomas, offering 18 holes of challenging play with sweeping ocean views. And if relaxation is the goal, the Guerlain Spa delivers world-class treatments in an equally stunning setting.
pros: Championship golf course with stunning Atlantic Ocean views
Luxurious cliff-top location with dramatic volcanic landscape setting
World-class spa and wellness facilities with holistic treatments
Multiple award-winning restaurants featuring Michelin-starred dining
cons: Remote location requires transportation for exploring local attractions
